mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) above its 5-year median indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds its 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 251.0 indicates accelerating inflation, which typically triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Fed, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 251.0.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is low (UNRATE < 4.0) and the Fed funds rate is high (FEDFUNDS > 2.0), the combination signals an overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a strong labor market (PAYEMS > 148000) signals sustained economic growth and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when PAYEMS exceeds 148000.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO is above its 5-year median, robust manufacturing activity supports near-term equity performance, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds its 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) above its 5-year median signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 5-year median indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 3.5% signals an overheating labor market, which typically triggers wage inflation and aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5.
